title: Lessons on Geonosis
description: In an attempt to rescue Obi-Wan Kenobi from the clutches of Count Dooku, Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala faced a series of hair-raising perils on planet Geonosis. Jedi Knights took on Battle Droids in the ensuing arena struggle, a battle promptly joined by Master Yoda and his newly-released Clone Troopers bred on Kamino. Anakin learned much from these daunting challenges, and a confrontation with Dooku himself added to his warrior's education.
